decisions.reason: The DPA management software fits the firm's agency and compliance direction, has favorable customer feedback, and costs little to maintain.
The management platform is the flagship of the firm's agency-focused strategy and is featured on the home page, so dropping it is highly unlikely.
The configurable managed hosting plan is core business for scalable agency offers, though it may be restructured or merged into other tariffs.
Extended PHP security support meets agencies' need to secure legacy projects and fits the security and compliance promise, although it is offered only for a limited time per PHP version.
